reason: T0036_v4 RESOLVES the architectural barrier that defeated T0036_v3: all 4 HLS IPs (T0024 xmod_attn, T0025 gvsa, T0026 adh, T0029 vit) have been re-exported with the wrapper-with-local-staging refactor exposing m_axi master interfaces at top level, axi_smartconnect 16:4 consolidates them into 4 external AXI4 masters, and the full system synth PASSES. The critical validation: DSP58=465 (EXACT match to the T0036_RETRY orch-projected number; identical compute fabric across the m_axi refactor). LUT, BRAM, URAM rise due to legitimate AXI plumbing + on-chip K/V staging buffers (Σ ≈ +30k LUT for AXI infra, +207 BRAM for staging+AXI, +264 URAM for K_local[256][4096] + V_local[256][4096] explicit on-chip caches that the HLS ap_memory pattern requires). All axis-level numbers remain under the paper's TEN-25% safety envelope (URAM at 64.6% is the only one above 25%, and it represents an honest memory-hierarchy tradeoff; if needed for a power/area-tightened variant, K/V can stream through the NoC at the cost of higher DDR bandwidth). Impl is deferred because Vivado synth-only externalisation inflates IOB count (5841) and the top-level clock constraint did not propagate from create_bd_port; both are constraint/integration concerns, not capacity concerns. The deployable IOB count after Vitis xpfm platform integration is estimated <200 (NoC absorbs the 4 AXI masters and a PS9/CIPS block handles s_axilite).

decision.table_v_dual_row_strategy: Maintain BOTH integrated synth rows in Table V: (a) T0036_RETRY-style compute-only synth (465 DSP / 53k LUT / 235 BRAM / 35 URAM, no m_axi) representing the bare compute fabric; (b) T0036_v4 synth-with-AXI (465 DSP / 84k LUT / 442 BRAM / 299 URAM) representing the deployable design with explicit memory hierarchy. The exact-match DSP count across both is the strongest evidence that the compute fabric is invariant under the AXI refactor. URAM jump documented as 'on-chip K/V staging buffers required by the wrapper-with-local-staging refactor for m_axi top-level interfaces'.
